items.headline: 大馬士革咖啡館炸彈爆炸六死

items.headline: 川普年入22億美元史無前例
items.context: 史學家指出，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）去年個人年收入高達22億美元，是歷任美國總統中財力規模前所未有的紀錄。這個數字讓外界對總統公職責任與個人商業利益之間的界線提出質疑。
items.thread_text:
史學家說，川普（Donald Trump）去年個人年收入高達22億美元，在美國歷任總統中是前所未有的規模。相較之下，杜魯門（Harry Truman）當年卸任時僅靠一份小額退休金度日。這樣的財富規模讓利益衝突的界線更加模糊。

items.headline: 泰勒絲本週正式完婚
items.context: 美國流行歌手泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）與 NFL 球星特拉維斯·凱爾西（Travis Kelce）據報本週在紐約麥迪遜廣場花園（Madison Square Garden）舉行婚禮慶典，賓客均簽署了保密協議。外界稱這場婚禮為「美式皇家婚禮」，婚紗設計師人選至今仍是懸念。
items.thread_text:
美國流行天后泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）與 NFL 球星特拉維斯·凱爾西（Travis Kelce）據報本週完婚。消息指出，兩人租用了紐約麥迪遜廣場花園（Madison Square Garden）作為慶典場地，場館可容納逾一萬九千名賓客。所有受邀嘉賓均已簽署保密協議。婚紗由誰設計，依然是媒體最大的懸念。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 2 日至 3 日發佈的報導。

items.context: 本週英國藝文圈有三件值得一看的新作：紀錄片《Birds of War》記錄一段跨越戰火的愛情，Daisy Johnson 新小說《Long Wave》以三代母親為軸獲高度讚譽，加拿大藝術家 Terence Gower 的聲音裝置則以1775年歷史折射當代美加關係。
items.thread_text:
本週有三件藝文值得一提。

紀錄片《Birds of War》追蹤一段戰地愛情：黎巴嫩裔記者 Janay Boulos 在倫敦工作期間，與深入敘利亞採訪的攝影記者 Abd Alkader Habak 隔著螢幕墜入愛河。Habak 曾因一張抱著受傷孩子衝向安全地帶的照片聞名國際，後來兩人在倫敦成婚。

英國作家 Daisy Johnson 推出新小說《Long Wave》，跨越三代母親的故事，以一個在荒島上獨自被發現的孩子串起全書謎題，評論稱這是她迄今最成熟的作品。

加拿大藝術家 Terence Gower 在倫敦展出聲音裝置《Enemies and Rascals》，以1775年美國革命期間對加拿大的領土野心為素材，放在當代美加關係的脈絡下別有意味。

sources.summary: This documentary tells the story of the long-distance relationship between a BBC correspondent in London and a photographer on the ground in Syria with charm and humanity Politics is to some degree set aside here in favour of matters of the heart; this is a story of romantic love among the ruins. London-based Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos, while working for the BBC’s Arabic service, fell in love from afar in 2016 with Syrian activist and photojournalist Abd Alkader Habak. He, during the Assad regime, was putting his life in danger to supply her with dramatic footage from his home town of Idlib and later Aleppo. Habak was himself to make international headlines in 2017 by getting photographed carrying an injured child to safety. Habak’s gruelling images are interspersed with Boulos’s smartphone footage of her thoughtfully going up and down in the lifts at BBC Broadcasting House as well as home-movie material of her childhood in the seaside Lebanese town of Byblos; we get their tender texts and voice notes showing a growing relationship, sweetly calling each other “bird” and “little bird”. Finally Habak got out of Syria and into Turkey; the couple got married and lived in London, going on pro-Palestinian marches. Habak has mixed feelings about having to watch Syria’s final liberation on TV and Boulos goes back to visit her parents in Lebanon where the activities of Israel are stoically deplored, though Hezbollah is not mentioned. sources.summary: Covering three generations, this tangled story of secrets, childhood, abandonment and care might be her best work yet In 2018 Daisy Johnson was the youngest writer ever to be shortlisted for the Booker prize, for her debut novel Everything Under , a gender-fluid reimagining of the Oedipus myth involving canal boat communities and their complex family dynamics, plus a strange monster lurking in the depths. Before that, her short‑story collection Fen , with its blend of the uncanny and the workaday, was critically acclaimed. She has since written Sisters , a psychological horror that uses supernatural elements to explore sibling bonds and grief, and The Hotel , a series of seriously chilling interlinked ghost stories. Now comes Long Wave, which, while it shares some of these hallmarks, is in many ways finer and more subtle: perhaps her strongest work yet. Long Wave is a story of three generations of mothers. As a small child Ori was found after being “abandoned” by her mother on a wild, uninhabited island somewhere off the coast of England. What happened to Ori’s mother, and why they fled to the island together, only for Ori to later be found and adopted by a scientist specialising in hares, is a question that returns to her with full force in adulthood when she finds herself newly postpartum and struggling to cope. sources.summary: Artangel at the Maughan Library, London Drawing a line from the battle of Quebec to Trump v Carney, the Canadian artist’s takedown of rapacious US thuggery is strangely lacking drama Forgive me if you’ve heard this one before. The United States of America wants to annexe Canada. It starts by inviting Canadians to join the Greatest Nation on Earth but soon becomes more aggressive and strident. Canada, uninterested and baffled, stands up for itself. War looms. But this is not about Donald Trump and the bullying threats to Canada he has been making since the start of his second term. Except, of course, that it is, even though he isn’t mentioned by name in Canadian artist Terence Gower’s Artangel commission Enemies and Rascals – monstrous rascal though Trump is. Gower has created a sound installation deep inside a neogothic Victorian library to revisit the first time the US made proprietorial moves towards Canada – in 1775-76 during the American war of independence. George Washington – introduced simply as a “Virginia plantation owner” and Benjamin Franklin (“printer”) are among the US founders whose quoted words make them sound like rapacious thugs desperate to get their hands on Canadian land, particularly that belonging to Indigenous peoples. 本週建築和音樂各有一件大事。

2026年國際建築師聯合會（UIA）世界建築師大會在巴塞隆納開幕，各地建築師和研究者聚集討論氣候韌性、住宅供給、公共空間和職業未來。委內瑞拉、日本近期的強震也讓防災設計成了焦點。

倫敦巴比肯（Barbican），指揮家安東尼奧·帕帕諾（Antonio Pappano）率倫敦交響樂團（LSO）完成華格納歌劇《崔斯坦與伊索德》（Tristan und Isolde）的音樂會版演出。男主角 Clay Hilley 和女主角 Sara Jakubiak 均獲讚揚，評論稱帕帕諾和樂團是「最佳狀態」。

sources.summary: Barbican, London Clay Hilley was a blistering Tristan and Sara Jakubiak – in her role debut – a persuasive Isolde with Pappano and the London Symphony Orchestra detailed and minutely balanced The London Symphony Orchestra’s regular concert performances of complete operas have become something of an institution. Janáček’s The Makropulos Affair and Strauss’s Salome had critics raving about high-definition orchestral textures and brutally streamlined drama. But few operas are more obviously made for the concert hall than Wagner’s Tristan and Isolde . The composer designated it a Handlung (act or plot), yet Tristan stands out even among his narration-heavy works for its sheer absence of onstage action. No other more closely encapsulates his notion that operas should be “deeds of music made visible”. Tristan’s ultimate drama is rooted in the orchestra. Using the soft gestures with which you might stroke a cat (no baton here), Antonio Pappano teased the opening into being – unhurried, impossibly delicate, exquisitely in tune. There were harsh twangs of double bass and an oboe trill that cut straight through the thick symphonic texture. There was a horn lick I’d never previously heard and a troubled, circling bassline allowed more prominence than usual. The strings were instantly responsive, their articulation immediately hard-edged or cashmere-soft, their sound effortfully excavated or as light as silk in the breeze. items.headline: 政委楊珍妮霸凌成立遭免職
items.context: 行政院政委楊珍妮因職場霸凌調查認定成立，總統府昨晚發布免職總統令。前財政部長顏慶章另行聲明，指楊珍妮關於推薦顏慧欣進入 OTN 的說詞混淆視聽。人事總處確認楊珍妮依法仍可申請恢復退休金。
items.thread_text:
行政院政委楊珍妮職場霸凌調查認定成立，總統府昨晚（7月1日）發布免職總統令。楊珍妮卸下的是行政院政務委員兼經貿辦總談判代表的職務。

人事總處表示，她依法仍可申請恢復公務員退休金請領。

前財政部長顏慶章另行發表聲明，指楊珍妮聲稱是她推薦顏慧欣進入 OTN 的說法混淆視聽。

本館報整理自公視新聞於 2026 年 7 月 2 日的報導。

items.headline: 軍公教明年通案調薪4%
items.context: 行政院會拍板通過「116年軍公教員工待遇提升方案」，通案調薪4%，專業加給和主管職務加給各定額增加2000元，受惠對象包含軍公教、技工工友及約聘僱人員約72萬人。
items.thread_text:
🇹🇼 台灣相關 ——

行政院拍板「116年軍公教員工待遇提升方案」，通案調薪4%。此外，專業加給和主管職務加給各定額調增2000元。整體受惠範圍涵蓋軍公教、技工工友及約聘僱人員，合計約72萬人。

回顧近幾次調薪：2011年和2018年各調3%，2022年和2024年各調4%，2025年調3%。

本館報整理自公視新聞於 2026 年 7 月 2 日的報導。
